correctness.rationale: For the published Type-II log likelihood l(alpha)=r log alpha+(n-r)log(1-z^alpha)+affine(alpha), direct differentiation gives l''=-r/alpha²-(n-r) z^alpha(log z)²/(1-z^alpha)²<0 when 1<=r<=n, 0<z<1 and 0<alpha<1. The printed Hessian instead uses 3 and n-3 and lacks the entire alpha^-2 factor; for r=3 H_print=alpha² l''. Thus at (n,r,alpha,xr)=(10,3,1/2,1/2) literal inverse information is four times correct. Independent SymPy differentiation, common-denominator polynomial algebra and numerical substitution confirmed the two errors and strict concavity. Concavity guarantees at most one constrained maximizer if one exists, not automatic existence on the open interval.
